in_english.long_meaning: The name Azleena is derived from the Arabic term 'أزلية' (azaliyyah), which means 'eternal' or 'timeless'. This name holds significant spiritual connotations, symbolizing perpetuity and infinity. Historically, it has been used in various Islamic cultures to denote individuals of noble character and enduring legacy. The root etymology can be traced back to the Arabic concept of 'azal,' implying something that has no beginning or end.
